method: Aggregate of index hit-counts (calleja-index-raw.txt) + Phase 0 cite_check + Phase 2 deep JSON cross-counts (manifest.json:cite_check.other_key_theorists)

tier_definitions.Tier-A: Cited substantively in ≥3 units / load-bearing across multiple chapters / shapes core argument
tier_definitions.Tier-B: Cited substantively in 2 units / chapter-central in one unit
tier_definitions.Tier-C: Cited in 1 unit / passing or single-locus citation

stance_legend.extends: Calleja accepts core position then pushes further
stance_legend.cites-without-engagement: Named in passing, no argumentative load

interlocutors.name: Aarseth, Espen
primary_works: From Hunt the Wumpus to EverQuest (2005)
interlocutors.note: Cybertext + ergodicity foundational to Ch.7 narrative discussion; Hunt-the-Wumpus paper foundational to Ch.5 labyrinthine spatial typology; Genre Trouble foundational to Ch.1 ludology-narratology framing

interlocutors.name: Juul, Jesper
interlocutors.note: Half-Real central in Ch.9 magic-circle discussion; Ch.7 takes Juul-vs-Aarseth narratology debate without endorsing either pole

interlocutors.name: Murray, Janet Horowitz
interlocutors.note: Murray's agency/immersion/transformation triad provides scaffolding Calleja modifies; Ch.4 explicit engagement with Murray on agency

interlocutors.name: Ryan, Marie-Laure
interlocutors.note: Ryan's mediated-exegetical bridge to Iser + Sartre on imagination in Ch.7

interlocutors.name: Salen, Katie + Zimmerman, Eric
interlocutors.note: Magic circle, immersive fallacy, definition of games — heaviest index footprint of any interlocutor (35/31 in-text hits); central foil in Ch.9; their immersive fallacy critique loadbearing in Ch.10

interlocutors.name: Lakoff, George + Johnson, Mark
interlocutors.note: TIER-A DESPITE SINGLE-UNIT presence: supplies the experientialist-ontological framework for the titular 'incorporation' thesis; Ch.10 builds its synthesis on Lakoff+Johnson's experiential gestalts; foundational to the entire book's payoff.

interlocutors.name: Damasio, Antonio
interlocutors.note: TIER-A DESPITE SINGLE-UNIT presence: provides the consciousness-of-embodied-self vocabulary for Ch.10; paired with Lakoff+Johnson as the dual phenomenological-substitute anchor

interlocutors.name: Slater, Mel
interlocutors.note: Slater's binary presence framing is the central foil for Calleja's challenge to presence-as-imageability; 15+ in-text hits in Ch.2

interlocutors.name: Lombard, Matthew + Ditton, Theresa
primary_works: At the Heart of It All (1997)
interlocutors.note: Six-dimensional presence taxonomy central foil in Ch.2; 10+ in-text hits

interlocutors.name: McMahan, Alison
interlocutors.note: Ch.2 critique-base — McMahan's 3-D-games presence method is the most-directly-parallel precedent that Calleja amends
